description: NestJS organises a Node.js server into controllers, modules and shared services. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.
versionNote: Examples use NestJS 10 or 11 with Node.js 20 or later.
